generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of KPPP portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
For Details Refer Tender Notification And Conditions In The Bid Documents.

Acceptence Cancellation of the works are reserved by under signed without any reasons for the same.
Addendums/Corrigendums / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the website only.

All the scanned documents pertaining to bidder to be uploaded shall be in original and same originals should be produced to the Executive Engineer (at the time of Technical Bid Opening) who reserves right to verify the orginal documents before approval.
To qualify for award of this contract each tenderer should give all details and documents as per technical and Financial bid attached to this tender
Raw water & Pure water Sample must be tested in RWS DIV labs GADAG and Quality control test reports must be enclosed to the bills. Cost of all QC test must be borne by contractor.
If any date in the tender time table is government holiday, next working date will be considered
Incomplete / conditional tenders will not be accepted.
Tenderer must submit his present accurate postal address and phone / cell phone number
The tender may be cancelled at any stage without assigning any reason

The rates of items are inclusive of cost of materials, labour charges, HOM of machinery, all lead and lifts and all other charges to complete the work successfully as per specifications and as directed by engineer in charge of work
The tenderers must submit the scanned documents in pdf / jpeg form, not in other form.
Any objection regarding the tender must be submitted directly to Executive Engineer , not in inward.

The bidder must submit last 5 years Profit and loss account obtained from Chartered Accountant (CA) Only. Bidder must have annual contract average turn over for 2 years not less than amount put to tender. the bidder must have munimum assessed availble tender capacity amount put to tender as per formula in KW document provided here with.
For interpretations of clauses, conditions, spelling mistakes, etc., decision of Executive Engineer, RDW&S, Gadag is final
The work is subjected to Third Party Inspection and inspection by other Govt agencies Third Party agency is appointed by theDepartment empaneled by Chief Engineer RWD and S Bangalore
All Conditions As per Bid Document
Tenderer shall submit valid PWD/PRED License registration copy

itemList.description: OPERATION AND MAINTAINANCE FOR THE FIFTH YEAR: Operation and Maintainance of the Scheme as per TOR which includes providing sufficient technical staff, valve man, Operators, Electrician and Others who are required to run the system in complete manner and providing all materials, chemicals required for operation of Jack wells/WTP/Pipeline repair Works. (1) Regular Maintainance of Civil Sturctures like Jack well, Settling tank, Raw water Balacing tank, R.S.F/S.S.F Pure water Sump, Pump house MBT/ZBT & all Other Civil Structures. The Maintainance consists of all kinds of repair to damaged structures,cleaning,washing and painting for civil structures once in a year. All the infrastructures must be maintained in a good working condition, so as to ensure uninterrupted water supply to all the habitations through out the year. (2) Repair and replacement of damaged pipeline, valves etc if found necessary. It includes cost of materials, labour Charges and also monitoring of the systems. The maintainance involves Raw water Rising main, Gravity Main, Pure water rising main and maintaining the required discharge of water in each pipe. (3) Operation and Maintainance of Water Treatment plant including dosage of required quantity of Alum, Chlorine and Other required necessary chemicals including replacement of sand/filter media as required as per standard of Established norms from time to time. 1 Maintaining the quality of water as per the guidelines of CPHEEO Manual and ISI Specifications including cost of testing of water @ laboratary twice a month. (4) Operation and Maintainance of all Kinds of Pumping Machinary, Other Mechanical Components of this scheme including Electrical Maintainance Covering all repairs/ Replacement of Electaical Cable/Switch Board/Replacement of burnt parts of Machinary. All the Above repair & Maintainance will be carried out as per the Direction of the Engineer-in Charge for Satisfactary functioning of the Scheme to Provide designed discharge (LPCD) of Drinking water to all the habitatations of the Project. Note: Helpers/Watchman/Valve man/Electrician/Technical Staff are made sure that they are available round the clock for Maintainance @ Jack well, WIP, and pure water sump points. (1) The G.P or VWSC/Concerned AEE of the Project Should Certify the Satisfactory functioning of the scheme and based on this payment will be made to the Contractor (2) The Contractor Should Maintain a Log Book on the Working of pumping Machinery @jack well, WTP etc. the Payment will be made by the Engineer-in Charge for Satisfactary report at the end of every month. (The GP Secretary and Section Officer Incharge Of W.S.S Should give Satisfactary report) subjected the Conditions appended in TOR etc., complete with all lead and lift, loading and unloading as directed by the Engineer in-charge of the work.
